model_instrument.model_version: not exposed beyond product model name

selection_context.allowed_use: scope, anti-contamination boundary, semantic pressure set, researcher acceptance only
selection_context.forbidden_use: selection freshness-check web contents or any source-derived ADC historical answer

epistemic_status: all blind records are unsourced model-memory leads, not Fact, Judgment, Reality, Outcome or Evidence

shards.purpose: asset × indication × trial × regimen × endpoint/readout branching
ownership, license, territory, sponsor and China-to-global business-development trajectories
jurisdictional regulatory states, label scope, access, safety and commercial outcomes
failures, withdrawals, clinical holds, expectation revisions, rescues and counterexamples
atlas-only negative-space, terminology and cross-shard gap closure

blind_rules: No ADC web search, source retrieval, search snippets, current news, or source-grounded historical material may be consumed before seal.
GitHub reads for control-plane handoff, methodology, code invariants and non-ADC formatting do not count as historical ADC input.
PILOT-000 may define scope/product acceptance but may not seed historical Memory Leads.
Do not invent exact dates, precise numbers, payload identities, trial outcomes or rights carve-outs when memory is uncertain; preserve uncertainty and search keys.
Raw JSONL is immutable after commit; later corrections use separate repair/normalization artifacts.
A Memory Lead can challenge the archive but cannot publish or overwrite Fact/Judgment/Reality/Outcome.

seal.saturation_basis: last three atlas-only passes added 1, 0, 0 high-importance novel leads; bounded coverage review found no major gap blocking the second-industry semantic pilot
seal.reopen_rule: new model vintage, explicit scope expansion, or a later verified trajectory exposing a major blind-category omission

next_stage_boundary: Search may begin only in a new post-seal run and may never rewrite the blind JSONL.

raw_layout.format: JSONL pass records with embedded immutable leads
